faq_heading: New construction in Sullivan Station: your questions answered

faq.q: What have townhomes in Sullivan Station sold for?
faq.a: 180 townhomes sold in Sullivan Station at a median of $785,000, with the middle half between $720,000 and $850,000.

faq.q: How long do homes take to sell in Sullivan Station?
faq.a: In Sullivan Station, townhomes were quickest at 26 days at a median, and houses slowest at 36 days.

faq.q: Which homes in Sullivan Station are the newest?
faq.a: Of the homes that resold in Sullivan Station, townhomes had the newest median build year, 2014.

items.t: 68 houses sold in Sullivan Station at a median of $1,397,200 (middle half $1,249,500 to $1,551,250). A typical house in Sullivan Station spent 36 days on the market and closed at 97.0% of the asking price.
In Sullivan Station, townhomes sold at a median of $785,000 across 180 sales, and the middle half closed between $720,000 and $850,000. The median townhome sat 26 days and sold for 97.9% of list.

blocks.text: Source: Paragon closed sales, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026; medians need 5 or more sales.
How Sullivan Station compares with the rest of Surrey

items.t: Houses in Sullivan Station have the highest median of the 7 Surrey sub-areas, $1,397,200, ahead of East Newton at $1,382,500; the lowest is Queen Mary Park Surrey at $1,178,500.

Townhomes in Sullivan Station have the third highest median of 7 Surrey sub-areas, $785,000. East Newton is lowest at $616,750 and Panorama Ridge highest at $800,000. Bear Creek Green Timbers ($748,250) sits just below and Fleetwood Tynehead ($800,000) sits just above.

blocks.text: By build year, townhomes are the newest homes selling in Sullivan Station (median 2014) and houses the oldest (median 2010), a gap of 4 years.
